name: Crispy Aloo Chaat Nachos
classification_note: New vegetarian appetizer; must NOT read as generic nachos (D-74).
cooking_method: Boil then fry potato cubes; fry totopos; assemble with chutneys, hari, raita-crema and sev

portion.construction: chips on a board with crisp potato, sauces drizzled at the last moment

steps: Boil potato cubes until just tender, drain and air-dry; chill.
Fry cubes at 175 °C until crisp; toss with chaat masala and salt.
Fry totopos last; assemble with chutneys, hari, raita-crema, onion, sev; plate in 60 s.

plating: Chips and crisp potato on a board; sauces drizzled in lines, not a cheese blanket.
food_safety: Cool boiled potato quickly (two-stage) if held; fry from chilled.
Fryer oil management; shared fryer = no allergen-free claim.
